The plate looks like a side plate of about 20-22 cm. It holds three pieces: two pizza slices, one cheese and one with a more orange topping, plus a piece of garlic bread or cheese toast.

Each pizza slice is a thin triangle, roughly 12 cm per side. I'd put each at about 80-100 g, or around 230 kcal. The garlic bread piece is about 60 g, or around 190 kcal.

Total mass is about 90 + 90 + 60 = 240 g. Total energy is about 230 + 230 + 190 = 650 kcal. That seems a little high for slices this thin, so I'll lower it to roughly 600 kcal.
